canDoYue: 你識帶三月報銷同差額去採購審核，問帳簿會唔會批，同邊個做負責人。
canDoEn: Ask about a reimbursement, a variance, procurement, and the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can you bring March's reimbursement and the cost variance to the procurement review on Monday?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以將三月報銷同成本差額，帶去星期一嘅採購審核？
dialogue.say: Can you bring March's reimbursement and the cost variance to the procurement review on Monday?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I'll bring both files on Monday. The variance matches the ledger.
dialogue.glossYue: 我星期一會帶兩份檔案。差額同帳簿一致。
dialogue.say: I'll bring both files on Monday. The variance matches the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Will you sign off the full variance if procurement kept it in the March ledger?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果採購將差額留喺三月帳簿，你會唔會簽批成個差額？
dialogue.say: Will you sign off the full variance if procurement kept it in the March ledger?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: Yes. I'll approve the full variance on Monday, since procurement kept it in the file.
dialogue.glossYue: 會。我星期一會批成個差額，因為採購將佢留喺檔案。
dialogue.say: Yes. I'll approve the full variance on Monday, since procurement kept it in the file.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can the ledger list me as the owner, without reading every reimbursement line out loud?
dialogue.glossYue: 帳簿可唔可以寫我做負責人，唔使大聲讀每一行報銷？
dialogue.say: Can the ledger list me as the owner, without reading every reimbursement line out loud?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: The notes will name you as the owner, and I won't read every line out loud.
dialogue.glossYue: 筆記會寫你做負責人，我唔會大聲讀每一行。
dialogue.say: The notes will name you as the owner, and I won't read every line out loud.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: File the procurement note before the meeting, and leave it on my desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 開會之前將採購字條歸檔，放喺我張檯。
dialogue.say: File the procurement note before the meeting, and leave it on my desk.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I'll file that note before we start, and I'll leave it on your desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 開始之前我會將嗰張字條歸檔，放喺你張檯。
dialogue.say: I'll file that note before we start, and I'll leave it on your desk.
